static_traits.name: Chen Jie
static_traits.family_status: Marriednot yet育；有十位侄辈（侄子/外甥）
static_traits.social_status: Spousal support; a team background of working with fellow National Guard members, seen as needing to maintain a strong image, and usually rarely expresses vulnerability in front of fellow members
static_traits.medical_history: No major physical illness；without既往类似心理问题的治疗史
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, good logicality, able to cooperate in exploration; high self-demands with self-reproach; able to notice and describe emotions and bodily reactions

basic_info.main_problem: 每逢圣诞节将至时，因需要给十位侄辈准备礼物而感到overwhelmed与Anxiety，并认为自己负担not起；该压力逐年加重，影响睡眠与身心状态，并造成与配偶的Relationship tension。
basic_info.core_demands: 节日日益加重的压力与Anxiety已hard to bear，希望获得专业支持以更有效地应对这些感受。
growth_experiences: 自数年前起，每年在圣诞节前数月开始出现关于送礼的压力与Anxiety，自我施压以满足礼物期待，尽管尝试预算与计划，压力仍持续并逐年加重，影响睡眠和与配偶的关系。
在一次应对洪灾的救援任务中，与团队成功救出数十人，但仍因not yet能及时救下一名受困者而长期反复回想该事件，产生强烈负罪感与自责，伴随胸闷、心率加快、头痛等躯体症状，并认为“如果我再快一点/更高效，那个人就能活下来”。

core_beliefs: 如果我not能满足他人的期望，就说明我是失败的/not称职的
If the outcome goes wrong it is my responsibility; I should bear full responsibility for all consequences
表达脆弱会被视为软弱并被他人看轻

special_situations.event: 临近圣诞节时想到需要给十位侄辈都准备礼物，但自己经济上可能without法承担
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我not能为每位晚辈准备礼物，就说明我让家人失望、我是not称职的长辈
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 提前几个月开始预算与计划、对自己not断施压以试图满足期待
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我负担not起，他们会失望，我是失败的

special_situations.event: 回想洪灾救援中not yet能及时救下一名受困者的情境
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我have not救到每一个人，就等于失败/not称职
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Repeatedly replaying details, blaming oneself harshly, setting higher standards to avoid 'failing' again
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 如果我再快一点，他就not会死；这是我的责任

special_situations.event: Considers whether to express inner guilt and troubles to National Guard comrades
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果表达脆弱，他人就会看轻我、认为我not胜任
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 压下表达需求，选择沉默以维持“坚强”形象
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 他们会觉得我软弱、能力not行

special_situations.event: In the months before each holiday, mood starts rising and the worst consequences are repeatedly rehearsed
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 我必须面面俱到、一个都not能落下，否则就会出大问题
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: not断规划、反复权衡开支与名单，但同时Avoiding communication with others真实困难
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 如果我not能全部做到，就等于彻底失败，一切都会很糟

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be recognized and accepted, affirmed by others as a reliable caregiver/contributor
core_conflict.fear: 害怕让他人失望、被评价为软弱或not胜任，从而被贬低与疏远
defense_goal: 通过维持高标准与自我苛责来避免失败
在同袍面前Repression脆弱以维持“能干/强者”的形象

object_relations.self_representation: 需要时刻坚强可靠、not可轻易出错的提供者/救援者
object_relations.object_representation: 评判性且期望高的他人（家人/同袍），会因我的not足而失望或看轻我

object_relations.self_representation: 在关系中容易自责、对结果负全责的人
object_relations.object_representation: Important others easily disappointed or 'hurt/burdened' by me (such as a spouse, helpees)

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: 当谈及灾难救援中not yet能救下一人的片段，或被询问能否看到积极面
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 将他人的关注理解为对自己能力的检验，若承认情绪即等同于not胜任
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Steady tone, tending to narrate facts and details objectively and downplaying emotional words; when invited to feel emotions, shifting to discussing 'why it happened' and 'how it could be improved'.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When advised to express vulnerability to comrades or close others and seek support
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 认为表达感受会被看作软弱，进而被贬低或评判
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 简短回应并Displacement话题，降低情感强度；use“not事/我可以自己扛”之类表述，避免停留在脆弱体验上。

manifestations: 在洪灾救援中直面Death并对not yet能救下一人反复回想与自责
几乎每天都会被相关记忆侵扰，难以放下
outcomes: 胸闷、心率加快、头痛等躯体反应

manifestations: Highly compliant with the inner rule 'must meet everyone's expectations', has difficulty setting bearable boundaries for herself (such as the scope and form of gift-giving)
outcomes: 节日前数月即开始的担忧与反刍

manifestations: not愿在同袍面前展露脆弱，担心被视为软弱或not称职
outcomes: 减少寻求同侪支持的机会
Increased emotional burden、内在自责循环

contact_model.definition: The individual has poor self-reflection and self-reproach, involving excessive self-restriction, and is overly cautious about contact.
manifestations: 反复检视“是否足够快/足够好”
用高标准苛责自己以避免被评判
担心表达脆弱会显得not胜任

contact_model.definition: 个体将原本要向外表达的能量Turning against the self，对自己做，或克制对他人发出的行为冲动。
manifestations: 压下向同袍求助与表达脆弱的冲动
将失败与愤怒转向自责与自我苛责

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others.
manifestations: 预设同袍会看轻自己、认为自己软弱
据此选择沉默与回避表达情绪

positive_force: Has a supportive spouse并能沟通担忧
强烈的助人动机与责任感，曾在救援中挽救多人
愿意求助并接受专业支持
曾尝试预算与计划等具体策略
工作表现not yet受显著影响，基本生活功能保持
negative_force: 自我苛责与将责任全揽在己的倾向
Catastrophizing, black-and-white thinking, and prophetic worry lead to long-term stress
在同袍面前回避脆弱表达、减少获得支持的机会
节日前提前数月的反刍与生理应激反应累积
将他人期待内化为 rigid 的“应该”，对自身边界设定not足

target_behavior.behavior: 节日前对送礼的Anxiety与灾难化担忧（伴随insomnia）
antecedent: The approaching holiday and related prompts (shopping, budgets, family-and-friend gathering topics)
想到需要给十位侄辈都准备礼物且可能负担not起
target_behavior.core_reason: 将他人期待内化为必须达成的标准，并以“达成全部=合格；not yet达成=失败”的信念框定情境
target_behavior.function: Avoids the risk of being seen as rude/disappointing others, trying to gain a sense of control through excessive worry and planning
target_behavior.consequence: Persistent anxiety与Sleep impaired；与配偶Relationship tension，身心负担加重

target_behavior.behavior: Repeated rumination and self-blame over the rescue incident (accompanied by chest tightness, increased heart rate, headaches)
antecedent: 想到洪灾任务和not yet能救下一人的细节
相关线索（新闻、灾害话题、团队回忆）
target_behavior.core_reason: 将个体控制范围外的结果归因为个人not足，以此维持“我应对一切结果负责”的信念结构
target_behavior.function: 通过自责与反刍来避免直面without力与偶然性的痛苦，维持一种主观的控制感
target_behavior.consequence: Persistent guilt and physiological stress, worsening emotional distress, affecting daily rest and well-being
